name: Songbirds of the Seventies
blurb: A summer cabaret tribute to the powerhouse singer-songwriters of the '60s and '70s: Joni Mitchell, Carole King, Carly Simon, Stevie Nicks, and Linda Ronstadt. An easy downtown night out with shows nearly every evening plus weekend matinees. Tickets through Florida Studio Theatre.

name: Into the Woods
address: 3501 S. Tamiami Trail, Suite 1175, Sarasota, FL 34239
blurb: Sondheim's beloved fairy-tale musical staged by Sarasota's own Rise Above Performing Arts in their new home at the Crossings. This is closing weekend, and it is a family-friendly showcase of local talent. Tickets are $37 at RiseAboveArts.com.
photo_credit: Photo: Rise Above Performing Arts / VisitSarasota.com

name: Siesta Key Drum Circle
hours_label: Starts about an hour before sunset · Free
blurb: The legendary Sunday-evening drum circle on Siesta Beach, gathering roughly an hour before sunset just south of the pavilion. Drummers, hoopers, dancers, and one of the best sunsets on the Gulf, all on that famous quartz sand. Free and open to everyone.

name: Sarasota Farmers Market
address: Lemon Ave & Main St, Sarasota, FL 34236
blurb: Downtown's Saturday-morning staple: 70+ vendors with produce, fresh seafood, baked goods, plants, and live music at Lemon and Main. A great way to feel the pulse of downtown Sarasota. Free to stroll, rain or shine.
